question: Firoz Shah Tughlaq's tomb is situated in_______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Firoz Shah's tomb is located in Hauz Khas (New Delhi),** close to the tank built by** Alauddin Khalji. **
 
• **Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq **(1309 – 20 September 1388) was a ruler from the Tughlaq dynasty, who reigned over the Sultanate of Delhi from 1351 to 1388.
 
• Firoz Shah Tughluq contributed to architecture in a similar manner as **Shah Jahan** did years later. 
 
• Firoz Shah Tughlaq wrote an autobiography, titled Futuhat-e-firozshahi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tughlaq Dynasty was a Muslim dynasty of Turkic origin **that ruled over the Delhi sultanate in medieval India. 
 
• Its reign started in** 1320 in Delhi when Ghazi Malik assumed the throne under the title of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq. **The dynasty ended in 1413.

**Rulers of the Tuglaq dynasty:**

 
• 1321–1325 - Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq
 
• 1325–1351 - Muhammad ibn Tughluq
 
• 1351–1388 - Firuz Shah Tughlaq
 
• 1388–1413 - Ghiyath-ud-din Tughluq Shah / Abu Bakr Shah / Muhammad Shah / Mahmud Tughlaq / Nusrat Shah.
